ticket.subject: Loonexport
ticket.body: Kan ik de loonexport ook per week in plaats van per maand instellen?

decision.reason: How-to question about the payroll export period; F04 states exports run per week, four weeks or month, so no urgency and the help centre answers it. The Nmbrs, Loket.nl and AFAS integrations are Plus, which the reply mentions because the customer is on Basis.
decision.draft_reply: Hoi, ja, de loonexport kan per week, per vier weken of per maand. Dit stel je in onder Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll). De koppelingen met Nmbrs, Loket.nl en AFAS zijn onderdeel van het Plus-abonnement. Team Roosterly
decision.reply_english_gloss: Hi, yes, the payroll export can run per week, per four weeks or per month. You set this under Settings → Integrations → Payroll. The Nmbrs, Loket.nl and AFAS integrations are part of the Plus plan. Team Roosterly

ticket.subject: Kosten
